messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Your phone being in Airplane Mode is the issue. Airplane Mode disables all wireless communications, including cellular service, which is required for MMS.

Please turn off Airplane Mode by running: toggle_airplane_mode

After you turn it off, wait a moment for your phone to reconnect to the cellular network. Then let me know what you see in your status bar (signal strength and network type like 5G/4G). You can also run check_network_status again to confirm you now have cellular service and mobile data enabled.

I turned off Airplane Mode. Now my status bar shows excellent 5G signal strength, data is enabled, and my battery is at 80%. The network status confirms cellular connection with excellent signal on 5G, with mobile data enabled and data roaming off. What should I do next?

Please explain the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
